title: Help Center
body: Browse by category to find the answers you need.
gettingStarted1Question: How do I create an account?
gettingStarted1Answer: Click "Sign Up" and follow the prompts. You can sign up with email or connect your Google account.
gettingStarted2Answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required.
billing1Question: What payment methods do you accept?
billing1Answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans.
billing2Answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Contact support within 30 days for a full refund.
support1Answer: You can reach us via email, live chat, or through your account dashboard. We typically respond within 24 hours.
support2Answer: Phone support is available for Pro and Enterprise plans during business hours (9 AM - 6 PM EST).
